I do not play a lot of World Of Warcraft, so when Blizzard came knocking about an interview, my reaction was a blend of being caught dozing off in history class and being casually asked to defuse a bomb. But Undermine(d) does harbour at least one addition that an Azeroth tourist like myself can understand: cars.
 
Read more
articles.title: How drift racing came to World Of Warcraft

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Silent Hill 2 remake wranglers Bloober Team have emerged from the newly high-resolution, volumetric fog to threaten us with the prospect of another "game based on Konami's IP". Thank heavens, I was beginning to think we'd never get a new Frogger. Whatever the project is, we won't hear about it for a while.
 Read more
articles.title: Silent Hill 2 remake studio Bloober are working on another Konami game and it's "truly special"

articles.author: James Archer
articles.description:
A question, readers. What sounds more fun: doddering about on your own two feet – like an idiot – or storming through deserts on a cannon-packing megacrab? I only make such a clearly self-answering inquiry because for some reason DuneCrawl, or at least the Steam Next Fest demo that shows off its isometric action, seems to think both sides have valid points.
Read more
articles.title: DuneCrawl’s on-foot fighting is no match for its crab walker warfare

articles.author: Nic Reuben
articles.description:
Back in 2023, the Skyblivion team announced that their project to recreate The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion in Skyrim's engine was on track for a 2025 release date. Well, steal my sweet rolls and shout me off a mountain, the mad candles have gone and done it. At least, that's the plan according to a new live gameplay demo and Q&A video (cheers, PC Gamer.)
Read more
articles.title: Elder Scrolls Oblivion-in-Skyrim mod still on track for a 2025 release

articles.author: Greg Costikyan
articles.description:
Civilization is one of only two games I’ve had on every computer I’ve ever owned, in its multiple versions, since I first encountered it. (The other is NetHack.) It’s also important in my family. My wife plays it frequently (although she’s been on a Balatro kick recently), and I remember my middle child, in middle school, responding to a vocabulary quiz where they were asked to define “civilization” with the answer: “Civilization is a game designed by Sid Meier.” 

Obviously, I’m well disposed toward this long-running turn-based strategy series. But Civilization 7, as currently constituted, has some real flaws – and though I expect they may be fixed in future updates (and there are workarounds), some of this is a little sloppy.

The most basic issue is: combat sucks.

 
Read more
articles.title: Sid Meier's Civilization VII review

articles.author: Nic Reuben
articles.description:
My lunch yesterday consisted of air fried lumps of failed pizza dough from a disastrous first batch. One of my new year's resolutions was to learn how to make flawless pizza. This might be against the spirit of asceticism these goals usually incorporate, but such puritan edicts have no place here. The platonically perfect slice, like hailstones battering the word 'bum' into soft cement, is a natural marvel impervious to notions of morality both spiritual and profane.
Would the dough have turned out better if I'd sought the help of Into The Restless Ruins's harvest maiden, who grants the desires of those who petition her? Oh. Oh. The 'harvest' refers to slaughter, not grain. Should have guessed really.
Read more
articles.title: Stylish roguelite Into The Restless Ruins channels classic Warhammer Quest's dungeon crawling

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jiří Eischmann)
articles.description: Soukromí při práci na mobilních telefonech je dnes ohroženo nejen aplikacemi, ale i systémovými službami. Můžete vyzkoušet alternativní systém GrapheneOS, který sběr dat minimalizuje. Jak moc je to omezující?
articles.title: GrapheneOS: Android pro lehce paranoidní uživatele

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Dokončíme popis rozšíření instrukční sady SSE. Ukážeme si některé netriviální operace, které je možné provádět se skaláry a především s vektory. Jedná se o konverzní operace a taktéž o rozbalování a zabalování prvků vektorů.
articles.title: Pokročilejší SSE operace: přeskupení, promíchání a rozbalování prvků vektorů

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: ČD - Telematika)
articles.description: V dnešním souhrnu týdenního dění okolo kybernetické bezpečnosti se podíváme na Botnet Eleven11bot, odpojení polské vesmírné agentury od internetu, útoky na japonské společnosti a novou zranitelnost v Kibaně.
articles.title: Postřehy z bezpečnosti: nový botnet Eleven11bot otřásá kyberprostorem

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Projekt postmarketOS hledá nové jméno. Gentoo nabízí připravené obrazy disků ve formátu QCOW2. Nadace UBports Foundation oznámila vydání Ubuntu Touch OTA-8 s podporou VoLTE pro Volla Phone X23 a Volla Phone 22.
articles.title: Nové jméno pro postmarketOS, připravené obrazy Gentoo

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: PipeWire 1.4 zavádí podporu MIDI 2.0, Tails 6.13 přináší detekci problému s Wi-Fi připojením, GNOME přichází s minimem novinek, potěší ale na Filipínách.
articles.title: EU regulace v KDE, Wine uzavírá 20 let starou chybu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Dnešní přehled novinek chystaných pro jádro verze 6.15 není jako japonské jídlo. Vedle záplaty FineIBT-BHI věnujeme prostor novinkách chystaným specificky pro dva výrobce GPU s plnou otevřenou podporu v Linuxu, a to nejen pro RDNA4 a Battlemage.
articles.title: Obsáhlé novinky v podpoře GPU AMD a Intel na cestě do jádra Linux 6.15

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Ukážeme si základní vlastnosti rozšíření Postgresu, které se jmenuje pgvector. Umožňuje používat PostgreSQL ve funkci vektorové databáze, například při zpracování přirozeného jazyka, rozpoznávání obrázků, detekci anomálií atd.
articles.title: pgvector: vektorová databáze postavená na Postgresu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jozef Krajčovič)
articles.description: V čase vojen a kríz štát musí uvažovať aj o nepopulárnych opatreniach: o obmezovaní osobnej slobody a právu na informácie, striktnú politiku kontroly masovokomunikačných kanálov, a to sa týka aj používania šifier a kódov.
articles.title: Potulky tmavými zákutiami kryptológie: krízový manažment

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Svatopluk Vít)
articles.description: V druhé části obsáhlého článku se dozvíte něco o tom, čím jsem nahradil svou letitou zrcadlovku Pentax a jak vlastně vypadal upgrade. Co vyhrálo, jaké parametry jsou pro mě důležité? Co jsem koupil?
articles.title: Fotograf amatér: jaký přístroj je pro mě ten pravý?

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jiří Sluka)
articles.description: Pravidelná sonda do světa software. Podíváme se na platformu pro monitorování a správu clusterů Apache Cassandra, vyzkoušíme správce databází založených na SQLite a nakonec budeme analyzovat binární soubory.
articles.title: Softwarová sklizeň (5. 3. 2025): ovládněte databáze a clustery

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Vilém Sládek)
articles.description: Osmý ročník komunitního setkání nejen českých a slovenských správců sítí – CSNOG 2026 – se příští rok uskuteční 21. a 22. ledna, opět v prostorách zlínské Univerzity Tomáše Bati.
articles.title: Síťařské setkání CSNOG 2026 proběhne ve Zlíně 21. a 22. ledna

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Google dlouhodobě provozuje rozsáhlý program finančních odměn za nalezení bezpečnostních chyb. V loňském roce vyplatila na odměnách 660 výzkumníkům celkem 12 milionů dolarů, tedy asi 270 milionů korun. V loňském roce navíc firma systém odměn přepracovala a nejvyšší možná odměna se zvýšila na více než 150 tisíc dolarů.
articles.title: Google loni vyplatil 12 milionů dolarů v odměnách za nalezení chyb

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Western Digital dokončil své oddělení od společnosti SanDisk a nadále se bude věnovat jen vývoji a výrobě rotačních pevných disků. Elektronická úložiště v podobě SSD převezme kompletně právě SanDisk, který se stal samostatnou společností vystupující nezávisle na burze.
articles.title: Western Digital bude vyrábět jen rotační disky, výrobu SSD převzal SanDisk

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Společnost Microsoft zaznamenala malvertisingovou kampaň, která využívala škodlivý software hostovaný na serveru GitHub a umožnila tak zlodějům informací ovládnout téměř milion zařízení. Kampaň, kterou koncem loňského roku odhalila společnost Microsoft Threat Intelligence, spočívala v tom, že webové stránky se streamovanými videi obsahovaly malvertisingové přesměrovávače, které generovaly příjmy z malvertisingu za zobrazení nebo za kliknutí.
articles.title: Malware hostovaný na GitHubu infikoval téměř milion zařízení

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Aktualizace firmwaru 20250209, kterou společnost HP vydala 4. března pro modely LaserJet MFP M232-M237 podle firmy obsahuje bezpečnostní aktualizace, aktualizaci podle regulačních požadavků, obecná vylepšení a opravy chyb a opravy pro IPP Everywhere. Nic nenaznačuje, že by nový firmware měnil způsob, jakým tiskárny používají nebo čtou toner.
articles.title: Aktualizace firmwaru blokuje tiskárny HP a znemožňuje jim používat náplně od HP

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Asahi Linux snížit zátěž spojenou s opravami a zrychlit tok nového kódu souvisejícího s Apple Silicon do hlavního stromu linuxového jádra. Proto další vývojář souhlasil, že bude sloužit jako oficiální kontrolor kódu pro procesory ARM od Apple v rámci linuxového jádra.
articles.title: Linuxové jádro má dalšího správce kódu pro ARM v počítačích Apple

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Dnes vyšla poslední aktualizace řady FreeBSD 13 s označením 13.5. Uživatelé by měli začít plánovat přechod na současnou stabilní řadu FreeBSD 14 nebo vyhlížet budoucí vydání FreeBSD 15.0.
articles.title: FreeBSD 13.5 přináší vylepšení ovladačů hardware

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Sociální síť X (dříve Twitter), která dnes patří Elonu Muskovi, má problémy s výpadky. Podle vyjádření samotného šéfa společnosti za tím stojí rozsáhlé kybernetické útoky vedené proti infrastruktuře firmy. Proti společnosti X byl (stále je) veden masivní kybernetický útok, napsal Musk. Útočí na nás každý den, ale tento útok byl proveden s velkými prostředky. Buď je do toho zapojena velká koordinovaná skupina a/nebo nějaká země.
articles.title: Sociální síť X čelí velkým kybernetickým útokům

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: xdanik)
articles.description: Streamovací zařízení Google Chromecast druhé generace jsou od neděle mimo provoz kvůli expirovanému certifikátu. Zařízení samotná jsou funkční, ale mobilní aplikace Google Home hlásí zařízení jako offline a multimediální aplikace zařízení buďto nevidí, nebo hlásí chybu ověření. Některé aplikace certifikát neověřují a s těmi pak zařízení funguje i nadále.
articles.title: Přestala fungovat zařízení Google Chromecast druhé generace

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Když byla Java ještě novým programovacím jazykem, přišla společnost Sun s nápadem postavit počítač určený speciálně pro Javu. Srdcem měl být vlastní procesor, který by dokázal přímo pracovat s bajtkódem jako svým strojovým kódem. Celá tato snaha se ukázala být komplikovanější, než Sun doufal, a proto nakonec myšlenku procesoru pro Javu opustil ve prospěch procesoru SPARC.
articles.title: Co se starou JavaStation? Samozřejmě rozjet NetBSD

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Wine 10.3 přináší několik významných vylepšení, včetně podpory schránky v ovladači Wayland – dlouho očekávané funkce pro uživatele moderních desktopových prostředí Linuxu. Pokračovaly také práce na ovladači Bluetooth a byly opraveny chyby způsobující pády a problémy s výkonem v různých aplikacích a hrách.

articles.description: With the new AMD EPYC 9005 processors there are SKUs up to 500 Watt with the likes of the EPYC 9965 flagship at 192 cores for Turin Dense cores or 128 Turin classic cores with the EPYC 9755. But for those looking at upgrading from an existing EPYC 9004 series server and bound by the motherboard BIOS support and/or cooling/power capacity, 400 Watts is a sweet spot. Many of the existing platforms designed for EPYC 9004 Bergamo/Genoa(X) and now extended for EPYC 9005 Turin are limited to a 400 Watt TDP. With the prior AMD EPYC 9655 testing I have already shown off the great Zen 5 uplift when maintaining the same core counts as Zen 4, but even sticking to 400 Watts at the top-end is room for more. The EPYC 9845 is AMD's top-end SKU for 400 Watts or less that allows for 160 dense cores (320 threads) per socket compared to the 128 core EPYC 9754 Bergamo. Effectively the same power level and 25% more -- and better (Zen 5C) -- cores. Plus with EPYC Turin supporting the new AMD P-State CPU frequency scaling driver there is greater headroom in optimizing for power efficiency if so desired. Here is a look at how the AMD EPYC 9845 delivers a great leap to performance and power efficiency for those looking at a surprisingly robust upgrade from prior generation EPYC 9004.

articles.description:
Last year saw Evil Empire kick off The Triple-i Initiative showcase, an event focused on announcements for indie games. Now the spotlight is back on the indie world in a second edition that promises “no ads, no hosts, just games.”


There’s no date in place yet for the 2025 edition of the Triple-i Initiative, but we have some idea of what type of presentation to expect. According to the press release and the teaser video below, this year’s event will feature a mix of launch date reveals, gameplay first looks, and world premieres.


In addition to a tease of “out of nowhere reveals,” Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core, The Alters, Endless Legend 2, No, I’m Not A Human, and Enshrouded will be among the titles on display. 




Evil Empire admits that The Triple-i Initiative started as an idea to announce The Rogue Prince of Persia. From there, additional studios got in on the plans to show off what’s in store in the future. Last year’s reveals also included news for Slay the Spire 2, Cataclismo, Risk of Rain 2, Palworld, and Vampire Survivors. 


As for Evil Empire themselves, Marketing Director Bérenger Dupré says they don’t have a “flashy new game to unveil” this time around. They still wanted to get all the other studios together again, though. “Dropping all these announcements from our corner of the gaming world in one big blast makes sure the entire show is fun to watch for our players, and for us too!” Dupré commented.


We may not know when this is all going down, but we know where, at the very least. You’ll be able to watch The Triple-i Initiative 2025 on YouTube and Twitch, as well as concurrent streams via IGN, Gamespot, and Steam.

It's very satisfying to pick up a bunch of gold bars in Fortnite and go on a spending spree. If you break gold rock veins, you'll even get a handy speed boost to help you charge toward other players and secure some easy eliminations.


However, you won't find these gold veins just anywhere. Although they spawn often on the map, you'll have to visit specific spots to take full advantage of them. Here's how to find gold veins for your weekly and event quests.


Where to find Gold Veins in Fortnite Chapter 6, Season 2


The best way to find gold veins in Fortnite is to travel around the gold-infused rivers near Crime City and Shiny Shafts. This region on the map's west side has golden mountains, rocks, and water flowing throughout it, with gold vein rocks dotted along the river's edges. 



Screenshot by Destructoid


Screenshot by Destructoid



Gold veins appear as dark grey and gold rocks that shimmer as you approach them. Unlike regular boulders, these rocks have much more obvious gold chunks sticking out of them, with small gold sparkles emanating from them. Once you see them, they become pretty easy to spot later. 


Each rock has 250 health, so you can quickly break them with your pickaxe or your preferred weapon. Having Gold Rush makes them even easier to break, so you won't have to worry about spending several minutes standing around and hitting rocks.


You'll often find clusters around Crime City and Shiny Shafts' waters, giving you an easy way to complete your weekly quests. The gold veins also drop the Gold Rush buff that boosts your movement speed and around 30 Gold Bars per rock, letting you farm some cash if you plan on visiting a nearby Black Market or vending machine.

WWE 2K25 Superstar Evolutions explained


Every wrestler card in MyFaction belongs to a certain rarity, starting from Bronze. The lower the rarity, the weaker its stats are. Cards that can evolve will improve their rarity and in-game stats. It's easy to identify cards that can evolve, as they have DNA symbols on their left side.


If you check out the screenshot below, you'll notice that specific tasks are shown on my screen. Once you complete all three tasks, your card will evolve to the next tier (Sapphire, in the case of Bronson Reed).


Image via Destructoid


The number of tasks that you have to complete can also vary. Usually, cards can evolve by only one tier, but it's still handy for improving your Faction. Getting higher-tier cards at the start of your MyFaction adventures is hard, so having a card that can upgrade by at least one rarity will be helpful.


For starters, we all receive two cards that can be upgraded. One will belong to men's wrestling and one to women's wrestling. I am sure we will get plenty more upgradeable cards in the future, as some are also available in the packs.


Certain wrestlers also have Persona cards available in the game, and you can get them to unlock alternative appearances for your superstars. Make sure to check this guide out to learn more about how to get all the available Persona cards in WWE 2K25.

Have you ever encountered a Golden Llama in Fortnite's modes? Although regular llamas occasionally appear as rare loot sources, golden versions are almost unheard of except during various events. Considering Chapter 6, Season 2 is all about gold, this one feels particularly fitting.


How to find Golden Llamas in Fortnite Chapter 6, Season 2


Golden Llamas are rare loot containers that spawn randomly around Fortnite's map. Since they have random spawns, there's no one specific location to camp if you wish to find them as part of a weekly quest or event. Instead, your goal is to survive as long as possible and move around the map in hopes of spotting one of these in the wild.


Screenshot by Destructoid


Golden Llamas appear as a goofy-looking gold llama that's slightly smaller than the player's model. If you're familiar with the game's rainbow versions from previous seasons, they look almost the exact same with a distinct color change. 


Since Golden Llamas can spawn anywhere, there's a chance you'll encounter them in strange spots like the sides of cliffs, near the edge of the map, or on top of massive mountains. I even found one of a cliff's edge that I could barely navigate, making it a little tricky to search it for loot. Sometimes, it requires a bit of trial and error.


If you're focused on completing your quests and don't mind risking a loss or two, you can start gliding from the Battle Bus immediately after jumping out to help you search for Golden Llamas from a bird's-eye view. Although you won't reach the ground as quickly, you might get lucky and spot one from the skies, letting you drop to its exact spot and claim it before someone else accidentally stumbles upon it. Otherwise, you can just play your matches normally and hope you find one by chance.

Wondering how to use Energy Crystals in R.E.P.O? As you complete your first few runs in R.E.P.O, you'll encounter a shop where you can buy upgrades, weapons, and more. If you're wondering what Energy Crystals are and if they're worth your time, see the full explainer below. 


What are Energy Crystals used for in R.E.P.O?


Image by Destructoid


Energy Crystals are used to recharge almost all weapons in the game, including non-electric things like the baseball bat and inflatable hammer. 


You can buy these from within the shop in between levels/ They are yellow in color and usually priced anywhere between $7k to $14k.


When equipping a weapon, you’ll see a white bar beneath its icon at the bottom of the screen. This tells you how much charge the item has available. Once all the bars are gone, the item cannot be used again until recharged with an Energy Crystal.


How to use Energy Crystals in R.E.P.O


Image by Destructoid


Luckily, it's a simple process to use Energy Crystals in R.E.P.O. Simply buy a Crystal from the shop, like any other item or upgrade. Once you return to your ship, you will find a crystal station on the right side. Here, you can pick up weapons and drop them in the little bin to the left of the machine. This will charge the weapon up and it is ready for use again.


Energy Crystals have a limited supply and will break once depleted. You’ll need to buy more, therefore, to keep recharging your weapons. Although it may be tempting to spend all your money on mines and grenades, it's a far better investment to save up for a powerful weapon and buy Energy Crystals to keep it charged.


Now you should be all set to use Energy Crystals and keep your weapons in working order. For more R.E.P.O tips and tricks, see our guide to finding a game group to play with.

The post R.E.P.O Energy Crystals: All uses and how to get appeared first on Destructoid.

articles.description:
Fortnite Chapter 6, Season 2 has numerous peculiar weapons, from the Sub-Zero Combat Kit to Big Dill's favorite, the Pump & Dump. Acting as both a shotgun and SMG, the Pump & Dump gives you a two-in-one special at the cost of using a bunch of ammo.


Where to find Pump and Dump in Fortnite


You can find the Pump & Dump shotgun-SMG-mix as chest loot, floor spawns, and player elimination drops during your Fortnite matches. At any point during your match, you can find this gun — usually as a rare-grade drop — like you would any other weapon.


Screenshot by Destructoid


Although the rarity of the Pump & Dump weapon varies, you'll usually find it as a rare-tier gun glowing blue. This makes it relatively common compared to epic, legendary, and Mythic-grade variants, but you won't necessarily see it everywhere. However, I tend to have much better luck finding this in Ranked mode than unranked, so it's worth a quick swap if you've yet to encounter this weapon.


How to find a Mythic Pump and Dump in Fortnite


Screenshot by Destructoid


Alongside regular chest and floor drops, you can find a Mythic-grade Pump & Dump weapon at the Crime City Black Market for one Dill Bit. Upon running in and approaching the spot Skillet hovers around, you'll spot a display case containing the Mythic Pump & Dump to buy at any point during your match. This one is, unsurprisingly, much more powerful than its rare-tier counterpart but is far more challenging to obtain. 


Since you need Dill Bits, you'll have to break into one of Fletcher Kane's vaults or armored vehicles to claim some of these coins before venturing to Crime City's Black Market and claiming the item. There's a high chance you'll find other players along the way, so watch your surroundings in case someone tries to initiate an unexpected fight.

The post How to find Pump and Dump in Fortnite appeared first on Destructoid.

Following a complaint filed two years ago by a national pay-TV broadcaster, police in Germany say they now have three main suspects in custody following a huge law enforcement operation. Over 150 officers carried out searches against 18 suspects in 17 locations, with the aim of shutting down an as-yet unnamed illegal streaming operation with an estimated 30,000 subscribers. The three men, aged between 36 and 59, face charges including suspected commercial computer fraud, which carries a potential sentence of 10 years imprisonment.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

Using iframe malvertising redirector URLs to generate revenue, and redirects up to five layers deep, malware payloads hosted on GitHub, Discord and Dropbox, acted as a dropper for additional payloads hosted elsewhere. Microsoft says the goal was to steal information and it believes almost a million devices were infected.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate Streaming Site Malware Campaign Infected One Million Devices

They propose a "Know Your Customer" (KYC) requirement for advertisers and a transparent repeat infringer policy to address the issue.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

Football league LaLiga, whose matches were allegedly offered illegally through the app, previously called for the directors of Google, Apple, and Huawei to face criminal charges. LaLiga criticized the companies for failing to disable copies of NewPlay already installed on users' devices. Google and Huawei must now testify as 'profit-making participants' in an alleged piracy scheme.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

Two decades earlier, Jeff Bezos stressed the importance of strong branding to fend off copycats. In 2023, that theory would be put to the test when one of Amazon's strongest brands was dumped in mud, then dragged through it for the next 18 months.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

Wicked director Jon Chu is a proud recipient, but the bulk of the accolades go to lawmakers and the U.S. Government's IPR Center, who helped to combat online piracy. From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.

articles.description:
A renewed attempt to introduce site blocking in the U.S. emerged in late January when U.S. Rep. Zoe Lofgren (D) introduced the Foreign Anti-Digital Piracy Act. The FADPA bill received the MPA's full support, and it now transpires that similar legislation is being prepared by U.S. Rep. Darrell Issa (R). A recent meeting to discuss the 'American Copyright Protection Act' was attended by Disney, Paramount, and Amazon, plus Google, YouTube, and Verizon.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Second U.S. Pirate Site-Blocking Bill Incoming: MPA, Google, Verizon Met to Discuss

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (Yuv422)
articles.description:
Dark Seed, a 90's point-and-click horror game from the mind of H.R. Giger, is now ready for public testing!
In the game you play the role of Mike Dawson, who just moved to a beautiful solitary mansion to pursue his dream of becoming a writer. You'll soon realise that the place harbors dark secrets, and you'll have just three days to escape a fate worse than death...
The DOS Floppy and CD versions are supported. The engine also supports a number of localised versions Spanish, French, German, Korean and Chinese.
The floppy version currently lacks sound effects but all other features from the original game should be present.
The engine also has the option of using the "arguably" better floppy music with the CD version if you have both.
To participate in the testing, ensure you have a daily development build. As always, please submit the bug reports to our issue tracker.
>
articles.title: A dark seed has been planted

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (sev)
articles.description:
Good news: We've been accepted again to the Google Summer of Code program!
So, if you feel adventurous (or RPGous) and would like to spend your summer with the cool team, we look forward to your application.
Fear not—we will provide enough handholding, explanations, and support if you can dedicate time to coding on our project, are an open-minded developer ready to learn, and do not hesitate to ask any questions. We've been doing GSoC for the last 18 years (oh my gosh), so we know the drill.
A list of suggested projects can be found on this page. If you have your own idea, we will gladly evaluate it. For example, this happened in 2023 with the Crab engine. The required information for your application for our project is listed on our Wiki.
To give you a nice boost, we have put together an impressive amount of information on the Google Summer of Code miniportal. So you can learn all the ins and outs of the process. But indeed, you need to start by joining our Discord server and follow the #scummvm-gsoc channel where you can engage with our mentors and the rest of the team.
We are looking forward to your fine application and participation!
>
articles.title: ScummVM has been accepted to the Google Summer of Code 2025

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (DreamMaster)
articles.description:
God of Thunder, the Zelda-esque game, is now ready for public testing!
Prepare yourself to take on the role of Thor, the god of thunder, as he battles his way through the three part game, facing enemies and challenging environmental puzzles, all to finally face down challenging end bosses, culminating in Loki himself.
The implementation in ScummVM is slightly different from the original, in that whilst it has a high score table like the original, you don't have to go through the steps of creating an account and being limited to only a single savegame. Also, unfortunately, the game uses a special music format that will need to be implemented from scratch by someone with experience. So for now, no music playback will occur, though in-game sound effects play back fine.
To participate in the testing, ensure you have a daily development build. The game itself is freeware, and can be downloaded from the Adept Software website. We encourage all players to submit feedback and bug reports through our issue tracker.And please take some screenshots along the way.
Have you the skill to defeat Loki, or will you be defeated by the cunning enemies, or be stymied figuring out the puzzles. Play, and find out.
>
articles.title: A bolt of lightning, a shocking experience

articles.description: Inovativní koncept, který velmi dobře funguje, pokud od něj neočekáváte realističnost (je to koncekonců adaptace komiksu). Nápadité, dojemné, technicky zajímavé, mírně retro. Spoustu podobných filmů v 80. letech produkoval Spielberg. (Ilča 80 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Here - 80 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Daniel Craig v moci drog a alkoholu klátí mladé hochy v Mexiku a chtěl by klátit jiného mladého hocha a otevřít si s ním mysl. Když si odmyslíme potenciální skandálnost erotických scén, děje se toho v tomto filmu velice málo a velice zdlouhavě, a spíš doporučuji Cronenbergův "Nahý oběd", který je o téže postavě a méně nudný. Vlastně mi tenhle film připomněl soft-core "artové" počiny minulých dekád jako "Emmanuelle" nebo "Divoká orchidej". (Ilča 30 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Queer - 40 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Slušně zručně natočeno, ale pokud už jste viděli pár dramat o zprávařích v 70. letech, nedočkáte se ničeho nového. Teroristický útok v Mnichově je jen jakýsi "zdroj dramatu" v pozadí a nedozvíte se o něm v tomto filmu o mnoho více než v prvních 20 minutách Spielbergova "Mnichova". (Ilča 80 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Mnichov 1972 [September 5] - 60 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Měl jsem zásadní problém s tím, jak je film POMALÝ. Nevydržím se dívat na pomalý tříminutový dialog se zcela nehybnou kamerou. Bez ohledu na to, jak zajímavá je kompozice záběru. Kdyby totéž natočil třeba Guy Ritchie, mohlo to celé mít 18 minut (místo 109) a výsledný divácký efekt mohl být stejný. (Ilča 40 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Na kordy [刺心切骨 / Pierce] - 40 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Velmi špatný scénář, který je nudný pro dospělé a nepochopitelný pro děti. Průměrné herecké výkony, rutinní režie a především zbytečně vyhozené peníze za drahou výpravu. Většinu filmu dělá dvacet zaměnitelných dětí několikrát totéž dokola (naložit parašutistu do vozu, přejet pár kilometrů, přespat ve stodole, naložit parašutistu...). (Ilča 30 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Tichá pošta - 30 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Zábavné a nápadité smrti, občas dobrý vtípek nebo extrémní WTF moment, občas originální audiovizuální nápad, ale jinak... nic. Na konci jsem si uvědomil, že mě od poloviny filmu přestala zajímat jeho zápletka a hrdinové. Těch WTF vtípků ve filmu není dost na to, aby ho samy o sobě utáhly. Byla by to super epizody nějakých "příběhů ze záhrobí", ale na celovečerní film je to bohužel málo. (Ilča 30 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Opice [The Monkey] - 60 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: Čistě konverzační film bez jakékoliv zápletky, který se snaží vzbudit mírně povznášející atmosféru a nějaké divákovo souznění s hlavními postavami (a nic jiného). Takové filmy mohou být dobré, pokud jsou výborně napsané, odehrané a zrežírované, což bohužel není případ "Opravdové bolesti". (Ilča 50 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Opravdová bolest [A Real Pain] - 50 %

articles.author: noreply@blogger.com (Unknown)
articles.description: První třetina byla výborná, atmosférická a chytrá. Pak přišla trocha (stále fungující) romantiky a v polovině se to zcela překlopilo v Resident Evil 11 (nebo kolik). Pořád to bylo celkem zábavné a vizuálně působivé, ale nemůžu ignorovat ten z mého pohledu promarněný potenciál začátku. (Ilča 80 %)
articles.title: Audio recenze: Roklina [The Gorge] - 70 %

It was discovered that OpenVPN did not perform proper input validation
when generating a TLS key under certain configuration, which could lead to
a buffer overflow. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a
denial of service or execute arbitrary code. This issue only affected
Ubuntu 14.04 LTS, Ubuntu 16.04 LTS. (CVE-2017-12166)

control channel messages with nonprintable characters. A remote attacker
could possibly use this issue to cause OpenVPN to consume resources, or
fill up log files with garbage, leading to a denial of service.
(CVE-2024-5594)
